submit_reasoning: The 134-bar price history shows a low-volatility series (CV ~1.3%) with a recent downtrend from ~42.19 down to 39.69. Seasonality detection returned zero strength, and anomaly detection flagged only 3 minor anomalies. I attempted both a history-only forecast and an event-informed forecast using three dated claims from the Zacks article (Zacks Rank #2 Buy, upward earnings estimate revisions, strong cash flow growth). All three events were rejected by the leakage-safe ablation gate — the article is a generic qualitative growth-stock recommendation without a concrete catalyst the model could exploit. Both runs selected the same ETS model and produced identical trajectories. The forecast reflects a continuation of the recent gentle downtrend, declining from ~39.48 to ~38.20 over 30 steps. I submit the history-only baseline (fc1) as the best available forecast.
